citation.title: GRU-ODE-Bayes: Continuous modeling of sporadically-observed time series
citation.authors: E. De Brouwer, J. Simm, A. Arany, Y. Moreau
citation.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 32 (NeurIPS 2019)

topic: Continuous-time filtering of irregularly, partially observed multivariate time series (GRU-ODE propagation between observations, GRU-Bayes update at observations).
own_question: How to forecast sporadically observed multivariate series (synthetic SDEs, MIMIC-III EHR, USHCN climate) with a learned continuous-time filter.
actual_method_and_evidence: Synthetic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck and Brusselator SDEs; MIMIC-III subset (21,250 patients, 96 variables) and USHCN (1,114 stations, subsampled). Forecasting of the next 3 measurements after an observation window. 5-fold CV with inner validation; reports NegLL/MSE versus NeuralODE-VAE, GRU-D, T-LSTM and others. The representation results for OU processes are theoretical constructions, not empirical demonstrations of physics. No fusion or plasma data.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Background only: learned continuous-time filters can alternate propagation between irregular observations with updates when observations arrive.
claim_checks.qualification: Concept from the machine-learning literature; not implemented in our study and not validated on CES or diagnostic voltages.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Forecasting of future observations from past irregular observations. This differs from our current-report CES nowcast. Computation latency is not reported.
validation_if_relevant: Cross-validation within each dataset; no untouched external campaign. Tasks differ from ours.
forbidden_inferences: Do not imply this method was applied to plasma, CES, BES or ECEI data.
Do not cite its EHR or climate results as evidence about nowcasting performance in fusion diagnostics.
Do not claim its continuity prior applies to our estimators.
Do not present it as a baseline we compared against.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Optional single citation in the theoretical background on irregular-sampling filtering. It is not needed for the fixed framing, and the paper should not suggest an algorithmic link that the study does not test.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
